additional_concerns: node.b66b3e831bb98a12db59dffa permits a TRUE result for a pending pre-effective application without representing the source's preservation of the existing approval or authorisation process.

The pending-application exclusions in the other candidates are supported as limits on reliance on this circular; they do not establish a permanent prohibition on the change or determine the outcome of the existing process.
The referenced FAQs and forms are unavailable in the packet, so detailed application procedures and the classifications of novel, complex and possible local policy implications remain unverified.
A TRUE result establishes only satisfaction of the represented prior-approval removal conditions; the source expressly preserves post-vetting and regulatory action for non-compliance.

Candidates differ in returning FALSE or OUT_OF_SCOPE for dates before effectiveness and legacy applications; neither output should be interpreted as an independent determination that prior approval is legally required.
